title: Glyphs exist, array does not form

components.text: Glyphs exist, array does not form
This means recognition passed but spatial validation or compilation failed. An array needs one outer circle and exactly one center; parameters and child arrays must lie inside the

pages.text:
• Two centers are rejected rather than choosing one at random.
• A boundary that is too small excludes inputs; with nesting, check the nearest parent boundary.
• On compile failure, look for missing match inputs, unconsumed runes, and nested operation types.
